item.title: Intel flags robotics readiness gap as robot fleets expand
item.summary: Robotics adoption is accelerating, with six in 10 senior leaders expecting their organizations to operate fleets of robots within five years, according to new Intel-commissioned research. But just 40% currently have a formal strategy for managing a mixed human-robot workforce.
